name: Hotel Stockerwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Stockerwirt is situated in the picturesque hamlet of Hygna within the Alpbachtal Valley in Tyrol's Kufstein district. The property is nestled in a quiet natural setting with scenic mountain views. In winter, guests enjoy quick connectivity to the premier Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski area, while summer reveals extensive alpine hiking paths. Amenities include a restorative sauna wellness area, balcony rooms, and an authentic restaurant serving Tyrolean dishes.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Stockerwirt in Hygna in the Alpbachtal valley offers peaceful alpine lodging, a sauna wellness area, Tyrolean dining, and easy access to Ski Juwel slopes.
